description: Phase 4: Causal Inference — causal discovery, counterfactual evaluator, causal feature selection

userStories.title: Causal discovery module
userStories.description: As the research module, I need a causal discovery engine that identifies directed causal relationships between market factors using observational data.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/causal/causal_discovery.py exists with CausalDiscovery class
Implements PC-algorithm skeleton for causal graph discovery
Accepts factor returns matrix, outputs adjacency matrix + edge confidences
Handles up to 20 factors with conditional independence tests
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-06-14. File: src/causal/causal_discovery.py. Tests: tests/test_causal_discovery.py (6/6 pass).

userStories.title: Counterfactual trade evaluator
userStories.description: As the post-trade analyst, I need counterfactual evaluation to estimate what would have happened if a different position size or entry timing had been chosen.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/causal/counterfactual_evaluator.py exists with CounterfactualEvaluator class
Uses causal model to estimate counterfactual PnL under different actions
Inputs: trade record, causal graph, market state at entry
Outputs: expected PnL for each alternative action
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-06-14. File: src/causal/counterfactual_evaluator.py. Tests: tests/test_counterfactual_evaluator.py (3/3 pass).

userStories.title: Causal feature selector
userStories.description: As the model trainer, I need causal feature selection that removes spuriously correlated factors and retains only genuine causal parents of returns.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/causal/causal_feature_selector.py exists with CausalFeatureSelector class
Selects features based on causal parents from discovered graph
Falls back to correlation-based selection when causal graph unavailable
Reduces dimensionality while preserving causal signal
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-06-14. File: src/causal/causal_feature_selector.py. Tests: tests/test_causal_feature_selector.py (4/4 pass).
